observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies lying on a concrete floor.
Each headlight has a clear lens, a circular main bulb housing, and an amber turn signal section on the lower left.
The housing is black plastic with a red trim strip along the top edge.
The design is consistent across both units, suggesting they are the same part.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight assemblies themselves.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
The setting appears to be a workshop or storage area with concrete and debris around.

claims.claim: Contact us for your Honda front and back lights all models available
claims.evidence: The photos show only front headlight assemblies; no back lights are visible. The claim about Honda is not supported by the photos, which show no visible Honda branding or model-specific design features.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight assemblies may not be compatible with Honda vehicles as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the model number or part number on the headlight housing, or a photo of the back of the headlight showing any identification tags or mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic front headlight, not Honda-specific

risks.risk: The headlight assemblies may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken bulb housing).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and bulb housing showing no cracks, scratches, or broken components.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or non-working

risks.risk: The part may be counterfeit or not genuine Honda parts.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlight showing any part number, serial number, or manufacturer label.

proof_requests: Close-up of the VIN plate, usually on the dashboard or door jamb.
A clear photo of the back of the headlight showing any part number or identification tag.
A close-up photo of the lens and bulb housing to check for damage.
A photo showing the model or part number on the headlight assembly.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
